title: mentha pulegium var. gibraltarica
intro: Mentha pulegium var. gibraltarica, commonly known as Rock Mint or Gibraltar Pennyroyal, is a variant of the mint plant species. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to alleviate digestive issues and reduce inflammation, which may be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Rock Mint include menthone, limonene, and other volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Its therapeutic actions may be beneficial in treating conditions such as indigestion, nausea, and respiratory issues.
